create_report_function_component: create a ReportFunction component that wraps a callable returning a string to report dynamic state
create_report_function_with_custom_label: create a ReportFunction with a custom pre_act_label to prefix reported output values
build_current_time_reporter: build a ReportFunction using clock.current_time_interval_str to report the current time as agent state
get_report_function_state: call get_state on a ReportFunction to retrieve its pre_act_label as JSON-serializable component state
make_pre_act_value: call _make_pre_act_value on a ReportFunction to execute the wrapped function and log the result
